title: Immobilizer — information only
body: Dodge / FCA immobilizer and SKIM/SKREEM-related modules are described at a high level for diagnostics context. No transponder programming, PIN entry, or security bypass is provided here.
footnote: Dodge immo lane: reference text only until gateway-backed reads are validated.

skreemModule.role: Sentry Key Immobilizer (SKIM) and SKREEM coordinate key authorization with the security gateway on supported model years. PIN-gated key learn is outside CU1 scope.
skreemModule.tier3Scope: Tier 3 shows SKREEM module role and technician warnings only. Tier 4 programming screen lists partner/manual SKIM key-learn steps when enabled.
